manifest.runtime: compiled frozen source states + eager BF16 math-SDPA native tail
manifest.optimizer: FP32-master AdamW, separate condition gradients accumulated in FP32, zero decay, gradient norm clip1
manifest.selection: fixed step count; reporting validation does not select checkpoints

identity_scope: Every checkpoint must contain the same complete prompt-index set, mapped to saved data.json; optional row identity fields are checked. Score files do not contain independently verifiable per-step token hashes.
intervals: 5000 whole-prompt paired bootstrap resamples; pointwise 95% intervals; conditional on these prompts and this single run, not training-seed uncertainty.
